notes.title: Update 4.08
notes.content:
Small last minute update because I realized that hidden gold coins were not counted in a specific location if a specific action was not initiated.
So I had to change the number of gold coin piles in the backyard. (Behind the barracks)

notes.title: Strongloween: The Escape is AVAILABLE!
notes.content:
Hello everybody,

Well, after so long, Strongloween: The Escape is finally available!
It will be 20% off during the 14 days of launch!

Enjoy it.

François Linck

notes.title: The game is coming May 8!
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

It is after a lot of sweat and work that I can finally announce[b] the official release of Strongloween: The Escape![/b]

I realize that it's already been 2 years since I participated in a Steam event with my version 2.0 demo. I have come a long way because I have been developing by myself this [b]adventure/action game[/b], which is inspired by Zelda and other Metroidvania type games, [b]for a little over 4 years.[/b]
For those who want to finish the game with all the bonuses (8 + hardcore mode) and finish all the difficulty modes, Strongloween: The Escape will easily promise you more than [b]100 hours of gameplay.[/b]

There you have it, [b]Strongloween: The Escape[/b] is finally here and will be [b]available on May 8.[/b]

Don’t hesitate to try the demo!

I wish you a good day!

François Linck

notes.title: The Final Version of Demo!
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

The game is almost ready so I'm updating the demo. I added 5 achievements, huge improvements and bug fixes.

[b]If the Saves are not deleted, delete them, there are a lot of changes and this could create bugs.
[/b]

I will come back to you soon to finally announce the release of the game which should see the light of day in May.
